brief.meaningEn: Have particular emotional importance in a person’s or community’s memory or affections.
brief.meaningZh: 在個人或社區的回憶與情感中具有特別意義。
brief.grammar: Pattern: thing/person holds a special place in + someone’s memory/heart/community history; hold may inflect. The place is figurative, not a reserved physical seat.
brief.register: Warm local-history commentary: a neighbourhood organiser tells a new volunteer why an old pier matters to many residents, without claiming every resident shares the memory.
brief.boundaryZh: 情感意義特別，不代表物件在客觀上最好、最昂貴，或人人都同樣喜歡。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是留一個實際座位；也不必因為仍有感情就拒絕所有新選擇。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說清楚某事物對哪個人或群體有特殊意義，以及背後的具體經歷。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 55, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The old theatre holds a special place in local memory.

listening.en: The old theatre had worn seats, but it hosted the first play that Lina performed with her father. It still holds a special place in her memory.
listening.zh: 舊劇院的座位已磨損，但 Lina 曾在那裏與父親同演第一齣戲。它在她的回憶裏仍有特別意義。
listening.promptZh: 為何劇院 holds a special place？

options.en: It is linked to a personally important first performance.
options.zh: 它與一次對她很重要的首次演出有關。

options.en: It has the newest and most comfortable seats in town.
options.zh: 它擁有全城最新、最舒適的座位。

options.en: Lina values it mainly because its seats are more comfortable than those elsewhere.
options.zh: Lina 珍惜它，主要因為座椅比別處舒適。

options.en: Everyone in town has the same memory of her father.
options.zh: 全城人都對她父親有同一段回憶。

listening.explanationZh: 她與父親在那裏首次同演，形成個人情感連結；劇院設備並不新。

reply.promptEn: Why does Arun keep a photo of the old library? He learned to read there with his grandfather; newer libraries are more convenient, but that shared memory matters to him.
reply.promptZh: （Arun 為何保留舊圖書館照片？他曾在那裏與祖父學閱讀；較新的圖書館更方便，但那段共同回憶對他很重要。）

options.en: The photo reminds him of learning with his grandfather.
options.zh: 照片令他想起與祖父一起學習。

options.en: Convenience is not the only reason a place matters to him.
options.zh: 一個地方對他重要，便利並非唯一原因。

options.en: The old library holds a special place in his memory because he learned there with his grandfather.
options.zh: 舊圖書館在他的回憶中有特別地位，因為他曾在那裏跟祖父學習閱讀。

options.en: He values the shared experience even while using newer libraries.
options.zh: 即使使用新圖書館，他仍珍惜那段共同經歷。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都根據與祖父的共同回憶；金句概括個人的特殊情感意義。

scene.promptZh: 居民多年來在舊碼頭舉辦社區音樂晚會；碼頭現已停用，但許多居民談起共同經歷仍很珍惜。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The old pier holds a special place in the neighbourhood’s shared memory.
options.zh: 舊碼頭在這個社區的共同回憶中有特別地位。

options.en: The pier matters chiefly because it is the newest venue for concerts.
options.zh: 碼頭重要，主要因為它是最新的音樂會場地。

options.en: Many residents value the pier, so every resident must feel exactly the same.
options.zh: 許多居民珍惜碼頭，所以每位居民的感受一定完全一樣。

scene.explanationZh: 許多居民與舊碼頭有共同的音樂晚會回憶，足以支持社區記憶中的特殊地位；不表示所有居民感受相同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項資料最不足以支持 holds a special place？

options.en: The café was where two friends met every week before one moved away.
options.zh: 咖啡店是兩位朋友在其中一人搬走前每週見面的地方。

options.en: A shop sells the cheapest notebook, but the buyer has no personal connection to it.
options.zh: 一間商店賣最便宜的筆記簿，但買家與它沒有個人連結。

options.en: A song reminds a family of celebrations they shared for years.
options.zh: 一首歌令一家人想起多年來一起慶祝的日子。

contrast.explanationZh: 便宜可能有實際用途，卻未提供特別情感意義的證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「新體育館更好，但我仍喜歡以前和隊友第一次奪冠的小球場。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: That court holds a special place in your memory because of the team’s first win.
options.zh: 那球場因球隊第一次奪冠，在你的回憶裏有特別意義。

options.en: So the old court must have better equipment than the new hall.
options.zh: 那舊球場的設備一定比新體育館好。

options.en: That first win proves every teammate must value the court equally now.
options.zh: 首次奪冠證明每位隊友現在一定同樣珍惜球場。

dialogue.explanationZh: 特別意義來自共同經歷，不需否認新場館設備更好。

speaking.en: The small rehearsal room holds a special place in my memory because our band first played there.
speaking.zh: 那間小排練室在我的回憶裏有特別意義，因為樂隊首次在那裏演奏。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪段個人經歷帶來特殊意義。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一名廚師如今在設備完善的廚房工作，但仍珍惜舊攤檔，因為她在那裏與母親一起學做第一道菜。用一至兩句英文說明舊攤檔的情感意義，不要說它設備最好。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出與母親學做第一道菜的經歷，以及現今廚房設備更完善的事實。

examples.en: The old stall holds a special place in her memory because she learned her first dish there with her mother.
examples.zh: 她曾在舊攤檔與母親學做第一道菜，因此那地方在她回憶裏有特別意義。

examples.en: Although her current kitchen has better equipment, the first cooking lessons with her mother mean the stall still holds a special place in her heart.
examples.zh: 雖然現在的廚房設備更好，與母親最初的烹飪課仍令舊攤檔在她心中有特別意義。

takeaways.en: Something can hold a special place because of a memory, not because it is objectively best.
takeaways.zh: 某事物可因回憶而有特別意義，不必在客觀上最好。

takeaways.en: To explain why something holds a special place in memory, name the person or community and the experience behind it.
takeaways.zh: 解釋某事物為何在回憶中有特別地位時，要指出相關人物或群體及具體經歷。

brief.meaningEn: Develop as observers watch or receive updates, without a later replay or retrospective summary.
brief.meaningZh: 事情在觀看者或接收消息者面前同步發展，而非事後重播或回顧。
brief.grammar: Pattern: event/story/drama unfolds/unfolded/is unfolding in real time; in real time is an adverbial complement modifying the unfolding.
brief.register: Neutral live-event description: a reporter tells viewers that a debate’s outcome is becoming clear while the broadcast continues, without claiming to know the ending in advance.
brief.boundaryZh: 即時看到發展不代表事件發生得很快，也不保證觀眾知道最終結果。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是把劇情像紙張一樣打開；預先錄好的重播不算同步展開。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清現場同步發展、事後整理與事件速度三個不同概念。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 56, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The drama was unfolding in real time before us.

listening.en: The town-hall vote was broadcast live. Viewers watched each result arrive and the debate unfold in real time, without knowing the final count yet.
listening.zh: 市政廳投票以直播方式播出。觀眾看着結果逐項公布、辯論即時展開，當時尚不知道最後票數。
listening.promptZh: debate unfold in real time 指甚麼？

options.en: Viewers saw developments as they happened on the live broadcast.
options.zh: 觀眾在直播中同步看到事情發展。

options.en: Viewers saw the edited recap only after the whole vote had ended.
options.zh: 觀眾只在整場表決結束後看到剪輯回顧。

options.en: The debate ended before the first result appeared.
options.zh: 首個結果公布前辯論已結束。

options.en: The final vote was known before the live programme began.
options.zh: 直播開始前已知道最終票數。

listening.explanationZh: 直播中結果逐項出現，觀眾同步看到發展；最後結果當時未定。

reply.promptEn: What can you say about watching the live cooking contest? The judges tasted dishes and announced scores as the broadcast continued; no one knew the winner beforehand.
reply.promptZh: （你會怎樣描述觀看直播烹飪比賽的情況？評判隨直播進行試食並宣布分數；事前沒有人知道勝出者。）

options.en: Scores arrived during the broadcast rather than from a later summary.
options.zh: 分數在直播時公布，而非事後總結。

options.en: The winner was still unknown as the judging continued.
options.zh: 評分進行時，勝出者仍未揭曉。

options.en: The contest unfolded in real time for viewers.
options.zh: 比賽在觀眾眼前即時展開。

options.en: The audience watched the judging happen step by step.
options.zh: 觀眾逐步看到評分過程。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說觀眾同步看到評分與結果漸次出現；金句用本課表達。

scene.promptZh: 一場校際辯論直播中，評判當場追問，兩隊即時調整論點；觀眾與參賽者一樣不知道最後結果。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The debate is unfolding in real time before the audience.
options.zh: 辯論正在觀眾眼前即時展開。

options.en: The viewers are seeing a replay edited after the debate ended.
options.zh: 觀眾看到的是辯論結束後剪輯的重播。

options.en: The final result was announced before the teams adjusted their arguments.
options.zh: 兩隊調整論點之前，最終結果已公布。

scene.explanationZh: 現場追問、即時調整及結果未定，支持同步觀看發展。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合 unfolds in real time？

options.en: A reporter posts each new result as officials announce it.
options.zh: 官員每公布一項新結果，記者便即時發帖。

options.en: A documentary reconstructs a finished event using edited interviews recorded weeks later.
options.zh: 紀錄片用數週後錄製的訪問剪輯，重構已結束的事件。

options.en: Live viewers see a performance change when the actors respond to an interruption.
options.zh: 直播觀眾看到演員因突發情況即時改變演出。

contrast.explanationZh: 事後剪輯重構沒有讓觀眾與事件同步看到發展。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們現在正直播社區會議，提案才剛提出，表決還沒開始。」你怎樣描述？

options.en: The discussion is unfolding in real time; we should not announce an outcome yet.
options.zh: 討論正在即時展開；我們還不應宣布結果。

options.en: Because it is live, the proposal must already have passed.
options.zh: 既然是直播，提案一定已通過。

options.en: The live stream is merely a recap recorded after the vote.
options.zh: 這場直播只是在表決後錄製的回顧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 直播中仍在討論，不能把尚未表決的結果當成已知。

speaking.en: The audience watched the final round unfold in real time as judges announced each score.
speaking.zh: 評判逐項宣布分數時，觀眾同步看着最後一輪展開。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出觀眾是否同步看到發展。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一個社區舞蹈比賽正直播決賽。評判每完成一組評分，分數便立即顯示；冠軍尚未確定。用一至兩句英文說明觀眾怎樣觀看比賽，以及他們尚不知道甚麼。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出直播與分數逐項顯示，保留冠軍尚未確定的事實；不要說進行得特別快。

examples.en: The final is unfolding in real time as scores appear after each group, and viewers do not yet know the champion.
examples.zh: 每組評分後分數便顯示，決賽正即時展開；觀眾尚不知道冠軍是誰。

examples.en: Viewers watch the contest unfold in real time, with new scores arriving during the live broadcast before the winner is decided.
examples.zh: 觀眾在直播中同步看着比賽展開，新的分數逐項公布，勝出者尚未決定。

takeaways.en: An event can unfold in real time without happening quickly or having a known ending.
takeaways.zh: 事情可即時展開，卻不一定很快或已有結果。

takeaways.en: Unfolding in real time differs from an edited recap shown after the event.
takeaways.zh: 即時展開與事後剪輯回顧不同。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Source is guide-written provenance; practice scenes are newly written. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Advance through every remaining stage to reach the final or highest point of a competition.
brief.meaningZh: 在比賽中跨過往後各階段，晉級至決賽或最高階段。
brief.grammar: Pattern: team/athlete hopes to go all the way; went all the way in + competition. In this lesson the context explicitly establishes competition stages, because the phrase has other uses.
brief.register: Informal sports prediction: a coach tells supporters a team hopes to reach the final but has not done so yet.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課只教比賽晉級用法；有信心或贏了一場，不等於已晉級到最後。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是字面走完整條路，也不把「希望一路晉級」誤寫成「已奪冠」。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清目標、當前輪次與實際晉級結果，準確使用希望或已完成的時態。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 56, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She hopes to go all the way this season.

listening.en: The underdog team has won two knockout matches and hopes to go all the way, although the semi-final is still ahead.
listening.zh: 這支不被看好的隊伍已贏兩場淘汰賽，希望一路晉級到最後，但準決賽仍未舉行。
listening.promptZh: hopes to go all the way 在此指甚麼？

options.en: The team aims to reach the final stage of the competition.
options.zh: 球隊目標是晉級到比賽的最後階段。

options.en: The team has already won the final.
options.zh: 球隊已贏得決賽。

options.en: The team is content with its first two wins and has no further goal.
options.zh: 球隊滿足於首兩場勝仗，不再有下一個目標。

options.en: The team will skip the semi-final automatically.
options.zh: 球隊會自動跳過準決賽。

listening.explanationZh: 這是對往後輪次的目標；準決賽尚未舉行，不能說已奪冠。

reply.promptEn: What can you say about the basketball club’s ambition after it reached the quarter-final? The semi-final and final are still to come, and the players want to reach the last match.
reply.promptZh: （籃球會晉身八強後，你會怎樣描述他們的目標？準決賽和決賽仍未舉行，球員希望打進最後一場。）

options.en: The players want to progress beyond the remaining rounds.
options.zh: 球員想在餘下輪次繼續晉級。

options.en: They are aiming to play in the last match.
options.zh: 他們目標是打進最後一場。

options.en: They hope to go all the way in the tournament.
options.zh: 他們希望在賽事中一路晉級到最後。

options.en: Reaching the quarter-final has not ended their ambitions.
options.zh: 打進八強沒有令他們停止追求更遠目標。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都談尚未完成的晉級目標；金句保留 hope 而不是聲稱已勝出。

scene.promptZh: 一名跑手已通過預賽，下週才參加準決賽；若能再贏一場，便可打進決賽。教練認為她有這個機會。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She may go all the way, but she still has to win the semi-final.
options.zh: 她可能一路晉級到最後，但仍要先贏得準決賽。

options.en: She has already secured the final place without needing the semi-final.
options.zh: 她不用比準決賽，已經取得決賽席位。

options.en: She can reach the final only if the remaining races are cancelled.
options.zh: 只有餘下比賽取消，她才能打進決賽。

scene.explanationZh: 她尚未參加準決賽，may 正確保留一路晉級到最後的可能性。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不支持「球隊 went all the way」的已完成說法？

options.en: The team reached the final after winning every earlier knockout round.
options.zh: 球隊贏盡較早的淘汰賽，打進決賽。

options.en: The team hopes to reach the final but has only played its first match.
options.zh: 球隊希望打進決賽，但目前只踢了第一場。

options.en: The team advanced through all qualifying rounds to the championship match.
options.zh: 球隊通過所有資格賽，晉身爭冠最後一場。

contrast.explanationZh: 希望與完成不同；只打首場不能用過去式斷言一路晉級到最後。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「他們今天贏了八強，明天才打四強，但我想說他們已經 go all the way。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: They could go all the way, but the semi-final and final are still ahead.
options.zh: 他們有可能一路晉級到最後，但四強和決賽仍未舉行。

options.en: Winning the quarter-final means the final has already been played.
options.zh: 贏了八強就表示決賽已舉行。

options.en: Since they have another match tomorrow, they cannot aim for the final.
options.zh: 既然明天還有比賽，他們就不能以決賽為目標。

dialogue.explanationZh: 用 could 保留可能性，並準確交代尚未完成的輪次。

speaking.en: The young team hopes to go all the way, but its semi-final is not until next week.
speaking.zh: 年輕球隊希望一路晉級到最後，但準決賽下週才舉行。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出這是目標還是已完成的結果。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一支校際羽毛球隊首次打進八強。四強賽下週才開始，決賽更在其後；隊員希望打進最後一場。用一至兩句英文描述目標與未完成的輪次。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出希望晉級到最後，但四強和決賽仍未舉行；不要說已奪冠。

examples.en: The badminton team hopes to go all the way, but the semi-final and final are still ahead.
examples.zh: 羽毛球隊希望一路晉級到最後，但準決賽和決賽仍未舉行。

examples.en: After reaching the quarter-final for the first time, the players want to go all the way to the last match; they have not won it yet.
examples.zh: 首次打進八強後，球員希望一路晉級到最後一場；他們尚未贏得那場比賽。

takeaways.en: Hoping to go all the way names a goal, not a title already won.
takeaways.zh: 希望一路晉級到最後是目標，不是已奪冠。

takeaways.en: In sports, go all the way should be grounded in actual competition stages.
takeaways.zh: 在體育語境使用一路晉級到最後，應交代實際賽事階段。

lessons.titleEn: put a place on the map

brief.meaningEn: Make a place widely known beyond its previous audience through an achievement or event.
brief.meaningZh: 透過成就或事件，令一個地方在原有圈子以外廣為人知。
brief.grammar: Pattern: achievement/performer puts a named place on the map; put is unchanged in past, puts in third-person present. The place is the object before on the map.
brief.register: Positive cultural commentary: a local music organiser tells journalists how a song brought outside attention to a town, without guaranteeing tourism or economic gains.
brief.boundaryZh: 知名度提升不等於地圖真的新增地名，也不保證訪客、收入或居民生活立即改善。
brief.misconceptionZh: 地方本來就在地圖上；片語指外界認識它，不是重新測量位置。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪項作品或成就帶來外界關注，以及受關注的是哪個地方。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 57, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A hit song can put their country or city on the map.
sources.expression: put their country or city on the map

listening.en: A band from a quiet port town released a song that reached listeners across the region. The hit put their town on the map, even though visitor numbers had not been measured yet.
listening.zh: 一隊來自寧靜港口小鎮的樂隊推出一首歌曲，傳到區內各地聽眾耳中。熱門歌曲令他們的小鎮廣為人知，但訪客數目尚未統計。
listening.promptZh: put their town on the map 指甚麼？

options.en: The song made the port town better known outside its area.
options.zh: 歌曲令港口小鎮在本區以外更廣為人知。

options.en: The town was already known across the region before the song appeared.
options.zh: 歌曲推出前，小鎮已在區內各地廣為人知。

options.en: Visitor numbers are confirmed to have doubled.
options.zh: 已確認訪客數目增加一倍。

options.en: The song drew attention only from people who already knew the town.
options.zh: 歌曲只引起原本已認識小鎮的人注意。

listening.explanationZh: 歌曲傳到區外，支持知名度提高；題目明說訪客數目尚未統計。

reply.promptEn: What has changed in attention to Lark Bay? A local choir’s recording was shared nationally, and reporters who had never heard of the village began covering its music; nobody has counted tourism yet.
reply.promptZh: （Lark Bay 受到的關注有何變化？本地合唱團的錄音在全國流傳，原本不知道村莊的記者開始報道當地音樂；目前尚未統計旅遊數據。）

options.en: The recording introduced the village to a wider audience.
options.zh: 錄音讓更廣泛的聽眾認識村莊。

options.en: National sharing brought attention from reporters outside the area.
options.zh: 全國流傳令區外記者開始關注。

options.en: The choir put the village on the map through its recording.
options.zh: 合唱團透過錄音令村莊廣為人知。

options.en: The village is being discussed beyond its local community.
options.zh: 村莊現正受到本地社區以外的人討論。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明作品令村莊在區外受注目，沒有推斷旅遊人數。

scene.promptZh: 某島上青年隊贏得全國機械人比賽，原本不認識該島的媒體開始介紹其學校。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The team’s win put the island on the map.
options.zh: 隊伍奪冠令這座島廣為人知。

options.en: The island was already widely covered by those national outlets before the win.
options.zh: 那些全國媒體在奪冠前已廣泛報道這座島。

options.en: The win proves the island has gained visitors and new jobs already.
options.zh: 奪冠證明島上訪客和新工作已經增加。

scene.explanationZh: 全國媒體的新關注支持知名度提高，不涉及地圖或就業保證。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項資料最不足以支持 put the place on the map？

options.en: A film about the town is watched nationally for the first time.
options.zh: 一部關於小鎮的電影首次在全國廣受觀看。

options.en: A surveyor updates the town’s road coordinates, but no new audience hears about it.
options.zh: 測量員更新小鎮道路座標，但沒有新的觀眾知道此事。

options.en: A local athlete’s win brings the village repeated national coverage.
options.zh: 本地運動員奪冠，令村莊屢獲全國報道。

contrast.explanationZh: 只更新實際座標，不代表地方在外界更知名。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們的學生電影在全國得獎，第一次有外地媒體提到這座小城。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: The film may put your city on the map, though we cannot yet claim it has increased tourism.
options.zh: 電影可能令你們的小城廣為人知，但我們仍不能聲稱旅客已增加。

options.en: A national award proves the city has already gained more tourists.
options.zh: 全國獎項證明小城已迎來更多旅客。

options.en: The film brought attention only from people who already knew the city.
options.zh: 電影只引起原本已認識小城的人注意。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已有外地媒體關注，適合談知名度；旅遊成效尚未有數據。

speaking.en: The choir’s national broadcast put its village on the map for listeners beyond the region.
speaking.zh: 合唱團的全國廣播令村莊在區外聽眾之間廣為人知。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪項成就令哪個地方被外界認識。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一個偏遠山區小鎮的學生製作短片，獲全國電影節放映。原本不了解小鎮的媒體開始報道當地故事，但尚沒有遊客數字。用一至兩句英文描述知名度改變，不要保證旅遊或收入增加。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出短片在全國放映與媒體開始關注小鎮；保留旅客數目未知。

examples.en: The students’ film put the mountain town on the map when national reporters began covering its stories.
examples.zh: 學生短片令山區小鎮廣為人知，全國記者開始報道當地故事。

examples.en: Screening the short film nationally may put the town on the map, but no visitor figures are available yet.
examples.zh: 短片在全國放映可能令小鎮廣為人知，但目前仍沒有訪客數字。

takeaways.en: Putting a place on the map means making it better known, not adding it to an actual map.
takeaways.zh: 令地方廣為人知，不是實際把它加進地圖。

takeaways.en: A film may put a town on the map without proving tourism has increased.
takeaways.zh: 電影可能令小鎮廣為人知，卻不能證明旅客已增加。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Source is guide-written provenance; practice scenes are newly written. No human or release approval is implied.
